verdict.rationale: SES publishes sending events (bounces, complaints, deliveries) to Amazon SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Firehose or Pinpoint through configuration sets, and receipt rules can publish incoming mail to SNS or trigger Lambda. That gives event subscription, but only through other AWS services rather than native webhooks. A community user built a Lambda to forward inbound email to their own HTTP endpoint, which confirms this kind of glue code is needed. Missing for 10: native webhook endpoint registration, documented direct HTTP delivery of events (no evidence that SNS HTTP subscriptions are offered), and webhook signing/retry details.
